rows.text: 1. At its meeting on 28 November 2005, the Monetary Council considered the latest economic and monetary developments and left the central bank base rate unchanged at 6.00%.
The minutes of today’s Council meeting will be published at 2 p.m. on 9 December 2005.

2. The Council also set the dates for its meetings in 2006 (every second scheduled meeting is interest rate-setting meeting): 9 January 23 January 6 February 27 February 6 March 20 March 10 April 24 April 8 May 22 May 6 June (Tues.) 19 June 3 July 24 July 7 August 28 August 4 September 25 September 9 October 24 October (Tues.) 6 November 20 November 4 December 18 December

3. The dates of electronic publication of the Bank’s Quarterly Report on Inflation in 2006 are as follows: 2 p.m., Monday, 27 February 2006 (short version), 2 p.m., Monday, 22 May 2006, 2 p.m., Monday, 28 August 2006 (short version) and 2 p.m., Monday, 20 November 2006.
The Monetary Council will issue a statement on its assessment of economic conditions simultaneously with publication of the Report.
4. The Report on Financial Stability will be published once a year from 2006.
The date of electronic publication of the Report is as follows: 2 p.m., Monday, 10 April 2006.

5. The dates of publication of abridged minutes of the Council’s rate-setting meetings are as follows: Date of meeting Publication of minutes of Council meetings Mon., 19 December 2005 2 p.m., Fri., 13 January 2006 Mon., 23 January 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 10 February 2006 Mon., 27 February 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 10 March 2006 Tues., 20 March 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 14 April 2006 Mon., 24 April 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 12 May 2006 Mon., 22 May 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 9 June 2006 Mon., 19 June 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 7 July 2006 Mon., 24 July 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 11 August 2006 Mon., 28 August 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 8 September 2006 Mon., 25 September 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 13 October 2006 Mon., 24 October 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 10 November 2006 Mon., 20 November 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 8 December 2006 Mon., 18 December 2006 2 p.m., Fri., 12 January 2007
6. At its meeting, the Council also discussed the November 2005 issue of the Quarterly Report on Inflation.
Simultaneously with publication of the Report, the Council is releasing its own press statement.
